RTT estimation API with RFC 9002 sample update logic and variance tracking.

# Purpose
This header defines a small RTT estimation API for packet transmissions to one destination. It declares `fd_rtt_estimate_t`, which stores the latest RTT sample, the minimum trusted RTT, a smoothed RTT value, a variance estimate, and a validity flag. The inline function [`fd_rtt_sample`](<#fd_rtt_sample>) updates these fields from a new RTT sample and an optional `ack_delay`, using the rules from RFC 9002 Section 5. The code uses floating-point time units and is intended for use in QUIC-style RTT tracking or similar timing logic.
